title: Sample Dashboards Projects
text:
candy project
Penguin Palmer Dashboard
My website

candy <- candy |> mutate(type ~ case_when( chocolate & fruity ~ “both”, chocolate ~ “chocolate”, fruity ~ “fruity”, .default = “other”
boxplot <- ggplot(candy, aes(type, winpercent, color = type, fill = type)) + geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.15, width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA) + geom_jitter(width = 0.1) + theme_minimal() + labs(y = “Win %”, x = “Candy Type”)
ggplotly(boxplot)
bar <- ggplot(candy, aes(winpercent, reorder(competitorname, winpercent), fill = type)) + geom_col() + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 4)) + labs(y = “Candy Name”, x = “Win %”)
ggplotly(bar)
